about_the_game:
In "Circle Mountain Circle Sea", you will play as a farmer, weaving a healing ecological network on your pasture by placing unique circular eco-pieces. This is a ranch simulation game that blends light roguelite strategy with casual layout gameplay, using geometric aesthetics and cute animals to manage your own ranch.

Game Features

  • Circular Strategy Layout Each ecological piece has a unique area of effect. Through stacking, chaining, and combining, you can create different constructions and tactics. 100+ unlockable pieces will give you countless tactical choices.

  • Light Roguelite Challenges Each planting is a brand new adventure: randomly generated pieces and enemies force you to dynamically adjust your strategy.

  • Automated Casual Experience After planning your ecological network, you can sit back and enjoy the perfect balance between strategy and relaxation.

  • Perfect for Short Gaming Sessions Each game session lasts between 10-20 minutes, making it ultra-casual for fragmented gaming time. No need to worry about being interrupted mid-game.
